faq.q: What is the origin of Kudret?
faq.a: Kudret is associated with Arabic. Kudret is the Turkish form of Arabic قُدْرَة (Qudra), meaning 'power, might'.
Yes — the underlying form قُدْرَت is Arabic.
Kudret can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Kudret should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ق د ر is Quranic (power), but Qudra is not itself a Quranic personal name.
